no_condition.why: INSTRUMENT-SELECTION RULE, NO MARKET BAR. The call - 'seam weather reads use LEVEL differences only; run deltas are intra-week instruments' - tells a reader WHICH served channel to consult; it states no threshold and makes no claim about price, direction or magnitude. Its one quasi-numeric statement, that across a multi-cycle seam the run-delta channel is 'STRUCTURALLY ~ZERO', is a descriptor with no stated cut, and the audit already refuted it on the corpus's second clean seam (20260713 d_gw_cdd h0 = +0.435 against a level difference of -0.778, opposite sign). Its trigger is a calendar fact (a weekend/holiday seam) and no numeric quantity in the served vocabulary marks a seam - flow_calendar carries cme_holiday and is_cme_business_day as booleans, and business_day_of_month is not a seam marker. Nothing to bar.

WINDOW DEFINITION PLUS AN UNSERVED DISTRIBUTION. The operative claim is an assignment - the pre-print window is REOPEN->10:30, not 08:00-10:30 - which is a definition, not a threshold. The one number the play carries, the ~49.5 percent median pre-print share of day travel (and the falsifier's 'trivial pre-10:30 share'), is a quantity the decision state does not serve at any grain: intraday travel decomposition lives only in the g<N>_mbo_evidence render, not in a state block. The trigger (EIA print day) IS served numerically - flow_calendar.days_to_next_eia_release == 0 agrees with is_eia_print_day 60 of 60 across g18-g23 and fires exactly 2 of 10 days in every block - but a day-class selector is not the play's bar, and the incumbent hand-curated map encodes bars from the read rather than calendar triggers. Curating the selector alone would present the mass claim as evaluated when it is not.

THE CLASSIFIER'S PRICE LEG IS THE BLIND'S DELIBERATE MASK. Both halves need price. The trigger, 'the session after a D-1 up-leg', requires D-1 price direction, which is not served (B-0713 stood the play down for exactly this reason). The classifier is a flow-VS-PRICE conviction read - an ALIGNED rally versus a rise on net-sell - so even though tape_conditions serves the flow leg at session and phase grain, the price leg it must be compared against is absent, and a bar on the flow alone would be a different quantity from the one the play tests. The '50-70 percent give-back' is a magnitude OUTPUT sized off the prior day's realized move, not a bar on any served quantity; the audit measured it capturing 2 of 21 conviction-negative cases (median give-back 21 percent), so it is also not a real population bar.

THE PLAY'S CENTRAL QUANTITY IS NOT SERVED AT ALL. It instructs the receiving specialist to consume a PROGRAM-DECONTAMINATED D-1 residual tilt in place of session_signed_flow's sign, and that decontamination requires a big-print COHORT decomposition of the D-1 tape. tape_conditions serves session and phase aggregates plus big_print_b_share and big_prints_n, and no cohort split - C stated this twice inside G23 ('no big-print cohort decomposition in the slice... decontamination executed as a declared PROXY, not a measurement'), so on 4 of the 5 usable G23 program days what ran under this play's name was hand-built. Naming any served flow field here would be the hole-#8 error. Separately, the trigger is a property of D-1 (a scheduled program on the prior session) while flow_calendar's numeric roll/expiry/opex fields describe the DECISION day, so no served path expresses the trigger at day-D grain either. The play states no threshold beyond a sign.

NO SIGNATURE THRESHOLD IS RECORDED, AND THE CONSEQUENCE VARIABLE IS PRICE-DERIVED. 'A session phase prices materially on near-zero net flow' carries no cut for 'materially' or 'near-zero'; the audit had to invent one to scan (|sflow| <= 200, |pxchg| >= 300, vol >= 20,000) and labelled it explicitly as its own, finding five candidates where the record claims exactly two. The play's own forward note admits the scan is unauditable for this reason. The flow axis is served (tape_conditions phase_signed_flow, phase_volume_lots) but the price axis - phase price change, and the impact coefficient k3 = |price change| / |signed flow| that the collapse is measured on - is not served in any state block; k3 is reconstructed from the actual/evidence renders. A bar written on the flow half alone would fire on a different object from the one the play names.

TWO AXES ARE REQUIRED AND ONE OF THEM IS NOT SERVED; NEITHER CARRIES A PUBLISHED CUT. The play's own requires field states that separating a withdrawn book from an absent book needs BOTH flow intensity AND price efficiency (E-0717's correction to its own proposal). Price efficiency - price change per unit volume at the phase grain - is not served in the decision state. And no threshold is written for either axis: the numbers in the record (0.011 percent intensity, 18.9 versus 140.1 USD per 1k lots, impact 0.32 versus 169 USD per lot) are measurements of specific phases, not bars, which is precisely why B-0713's counter-object 'forced a THRESHOLD instead of a signature' - a threshold that has not yet been written down. The one blind-available field offered, l1_book.quote_bid_share, is declared a LABELLER rather than a gate and was measured null as a direction signal (9 fires / 4 hits across G21-G23); its cited 0.475 is an observed block minimum, not a bar.

EXPLICIT BARS ON A QUANTITY THE STATE DOES NOT SERVE. This play does carry real numbers - the trigger is a reopen-to-10:30 UP run of >= +300, and the arbiter is the 60-second post-release impulse, continue inside +-300 and full round-trip at <= -300 - but both quantities are intraday tape at 60-second resolution around 10:30 ET, and the decision state serves no intraday price path at any grain. The audit states it directly: 'the 60-second impulse values themselves are not in the committed corpus'. Its requires field says the same thing in advance. The only servable element is the print-day selector (flow_calendar.days_to_next_eia_release == 0), and curating that alone would make the play read as evaluated on every EIA Thursday while its actual arbiter never fires - the exact failure mode the conditions slot exists to prevent. This is an execution-lane instrument, causally inside the day it adjudicates.

IT IS A PROHIBITION, NOT A THRESHOLD - the play's own health note says so. 'Burn may CONFIRM demand arrival and may DAMP a lean that contradicts it; it may NEVER license a directional lean of its own, and must never act as a SUPPRESSOR before magnitude is derived' places no bar on any quantity; it restricts what a reading may be used FOR. Its two named inputs are served and both move freely (est_gas_burn_bcfd 21.9-51.0 and storage.vs_5yr 86-162 across the modern blocks), but the play attaches no cut to either, and the balance term it requires is under-specified at exactly the point where a bar would sit: the audit found the cited quantity has TWO counter-signed limbs (vs_5yr widening 151->162 reads bearish while injections collapsing 87->61->41 reads tightening) with no rule for which carries the sign. Writing a threshold here would manufacture the specification the play is missing.
